explorer.projectSummary: Mitt 是一个极简的 JavaScript 事件发射器库，旨在提供类似 Node.js EventEmitter 的 API 但更轻量（<200b），支持泛型类型安全，适用于浏览器和 Node.js 环境。它通过 src/index.ts 提供核心功能，构建后输出多种模块格式。主要职责是提供 on/off/emit 方法以管理事件监听器。技术栈为纯 TypeScript，使用 microbundle 打包。入口文件为 src/index.ts。主要模块仅有一个核心文件 src/index.ts，负责所有逻辑。未读取缺口在于缺少 tsconfig.json 的具体配置内容。建议：1. 检查 tsconfig.json 确保 strict 模式开启以获得更好的类型推断。2. 考虑在 README 中补充更多复杂场景的使用示例（如动态添加/移除监听器）。未知设置：无。依赖关系：无外部静态导入依赖。安装/测试命令：npm install, npm test。阅读路径：1. 阅读 README.md 了解用途和安装。2. 阅读 package.json 确认入口和构建配置。3. 阅读 src/index.ts 理解核心实现。

mentor.architectureOverview: Mitt 采用单文件核心架构（src/index.ts），无外部运行时依赖。核心是一个泛型工厂函数 mitt<Events>，内部维护一个 Map 对象（all）存储事件类型到监听器数组的映射。架构特点包括：1. 纯函数式风格，不依赖 this；2. 支持通配符 '*' 监听所有事件；3. 通过泛型 Events 提供类型安全的事件参数推断。构建阶段使用 microbundle 打包为多种模块格式。

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ``` ### Typescript Set `"strict": true` in your tsconfig.json to get improved type inference for `mitt` instance methods. ```ts import mitt from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter = mitt(); // inferred as Emitter emitter.on('foo', (e) => {}); // 'e' has inferred type 'string' emitter.emit('foo', 42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. (2345) ``` Alternatively, you can use the provided `Emitter` type: ```ts import mitt, { Emitter } from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter: Emitter = mitt(); ``` ## Examples & Demos Preact + Mitt Codepen Demo
* * * ## API #### Table of Contents - [mitt](#mitt) - [all](#all) - [on](#on) - [Parameters](#parameters) - [off](#off) - [Parameters](#parameters-1) - [emit](#emit) - [Parameters](#parameters-2) ### mitt Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub. Returns **Mitt** ### all A Map of event names to registered handler functions. ### on Register an event handler for the given type. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event ### off Remove an event handler for the given type. If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'` - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove ### emit Invoke all handlers for the given type. If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers. Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke - `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler ## Contribute First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! Now, take a moment to be sure your contributions make sense to everyone else. ### Reporting Issues Found a problem? Want a new feature? First of all see if your issue or idea has [already been reported](../../issues). If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new). ### Submitting pull requests Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits. - Fork it! - Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com//mitt` - Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt` - Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature` - Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ``` ### Typescript Set `"strict": true` in your tsconfig.json to get improved type inference for `mitt` instance methods. ```ts import mitt from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter = mitt(); // inferred as Emitter emitter.on('foo', (e) => {}); // 'e' has inferred type 'string' emitter.emit('foo', 42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. (2345) ``` Alternatively, you can use the provided `Emitter` type: ```ts import mitt, { Emitter } from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter: Emitter = mitt(); ``` ## Examples & Demos Preact + Mitt Codepen Demo
* * * ## API #### Table of Contents - [mitt](#mitt) - [all](#all) - [on](#on) - [Parameters](#parameters) - [off](#off) - [Parameters](#parameters-1) - [emit](#emit) - [Parameters](#parameters-2) ### mitt Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub. Returns **Mitt** ### all A Map of event names to registered handler functions. ### on Register an event handler for the given type. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event ### off Remove an event handler for the given type. If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'` - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove ### emit Invoke all handlers for the given type. If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers. Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke - `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler ## Contribute First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! Now, take a moment to be sure your contributions make sense to everyone else. ### Reporting Issues Found a problem? Want a new feature? First of all see if your issue or idea has [already been reported](../../issues). If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new). ### Submitting pull requests Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits. - Fork it! - Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com//mitt` - Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt` - Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature` - Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`

## 仓库介绍

### 用途
**Mitt** 是一个轻量级的功能性事件发射器/发布订阅系统（pubsub），用于在浏览器和任何 JavaScript 运行时中处理事件。

### 类型
- **微内核设计**：压缩后小于 200 字节
- **无依赖**：支持 IE9+
- **功能特性**：
  - 支持通配符 `'*'` 事件类型监听所有事件
  - 与 Node.js EventEmitter 相似的 API
  - 纯函数式方法（不依赖 `this`）

### 技术栈
- **语言**：TypeScript
- **构建工具**：microbundle
- **测试框架**：Mocha + Chai + Sinon
- **代码质量**：ESLint + Prettier
- **打包格式**：ESM、CommonJS、UMD

### 入口文件
- **源码入口**：`src/index.ts`
- **主要导出**：
  - `dist/mitt.mjs` (ESM)
  - `dist/mitt.js` (CommonJS)
  - `dist/mitt.umd.js` (UMD)
  - `index.d.ts` (类型定义)

### 主要模块职责

#### 核心类型定义 (src/index.ts L1-L22)
- `EventType`：事件类型（string | symbol）
- `Handler<T>`：事件处理器类型
- `WildcardHandler<T>`：通配符事件处理器
- `EventHandlerMap<Events>`：事件处理器映射

#### 核心接口 (src/index.ts L23-L39)
- `Emitter<Events>`：事件发射器接口，包含：
  - `all`：事件处理器 Map
  - `on`：注册事件处理器
  - `off`：移除事件处理器
  - `emit`：触发事件

#### 工厂函数 (src/index.ts L46-L123)
- `mitt<Events>()`：创建事件发射器实例
  - 支持泛型事件类型定义
  - 返回符合 `Emitter<Events>` 接口的实例

#### 主要方法实现
- **on** (L66-L73)：注册事件处理器
- **off** (L82-L91)：移除事件处理器
- **emit** (L103-L121)：触发事件，先执行类型匹配处理器，再执行通配符处理器

### 使用示例
```typescript
import mitt from 'mitt'

type Events = {
  foo: string;
  bar?: number;
};

const emitter = mitt<Events>()

emitter.on('foo', (e) => console.log(e)) // e 类型为 string
emitter.emit('foo', 'hello')
```

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ``` ### Typescript Set `"strict": true` in your tsconfig.json to get improved type inference for `mitt` instance methods. ```ts import mitt from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter = mitt(); // inferred as Emitter emitter.on('foo', (e) => {}); // 'e' has inferred type 'string' emitter.emit('foo', 42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. (2345) ``` Alternatively, you can use the provided `Emitter` type: ```ts import mitt, { Emitter } from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter: Emitter = mitt(); ``` ## Examples & Demos Preact + Mitt Codepen Demo

Returns **Mitt** ### all A Map of event names to registered handler functions. ### on Register an event handler for the given type. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event ### off Remove an event handler for the given type. If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'` - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove ### emit Invoke all handlers for the given type. If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers. answer.architectureOverview: Mitt 采用单文件核心架构（src/index.ts），无外部运行时依赖。核心是一个泛型工厂函数 mitt<Events>，内部维护一个 Map 对象（all）存储事件类型到监听器数组的映射。架构特点包括：1. 纯函数式风格，不依赖 this；2. 支持通配符 '*' 监听所有事件；3. 通过泛型 Events 提供类型安全的事件参数推断。构建阶段使用 microbundle 打包为多种模块格式。

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ``` ### Typescript Set `"strict": true` in your tsconfig.json to get improved type inference for `mitt` instance methods. ```ts import mitt from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter = mitt(); // inferred as Emitter emitter.on('foo', (e) => {}); // 'e' has inferred type 'string' emitter.emit('foo', 42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. (2345) ``` Alternatively, you can use the provided `Emitter` type: ```ts import mitt, { Emitter } from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter: Emitter = mitt(); ``` ## Examples & Demos Preact + Mitt Codepen Demo
* * * ## API #### Table of Contents - [mitt](#mitt) - [all](#all) - [on](#on) - [Parameters](#parameters) - [off](#off) - [Parameters](#parameters-1) - [emit](#emit) - [Parameters](#parameters-2) ### mitt Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub. Returns **Mitt** ### all A Map of event names to registered handler functions. ### on Register an event handler for the given type. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event ### off Remove an event handler for the given type. If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'` - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove ### emit Invoke all handlers for the given type. If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers. Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke - `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler ## Contribute First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! Now, take a moment to be sure your contributions make sense to everyone else. ### Reporting Issues Found a problem? Want a new feature? First of all see if your issue or idea has [already been reported](../../issues). If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new). ### Submitting pull requests Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits. - Fork it! - Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com//mitt` - Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt` - Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature` - Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`

### 1. 核心实现 (src/index.ts)
- **工厂函数** `mitt` (L46-L123)：返回包含 `all`、`on`、`off`、`emit` 的 `Emitter` 实例。
- **内部状态**：`all` 为 `Map`，键为事件类型（含 `'*'`），值为对应监听器数组。
- **方法实现**：
  - `on` (L66-L73)：按类型注册监听器，支持 `'*'` 通配符。
  - `off` (L82-L91)：移除指定监听器或清空某类型的所有监听器。
  - `emit` (L103-L121)：先执行类型匹配监听器，再执行 `'*'` 监听器。

- **无外部依赖**：源码仅使用原生 `Map` 和数组方法，无第三方库导入。
- **构建工具**：`package.json` (L24) 使用 `microbundle` 打包为 ESM/CommonJS/UMD 格式。

### 3. 架构
- **单文件核心**：所有逻辑集中在 `src/index.ts`。
- **类型安全**：泛型 `Events` 定义事件类型映射，支持严格类型检查。
- **模块化输出**：`package.json` (L5-L8) 定义多格式导出路径。

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ``` ### Typescript Set `"strict": true` in your tsconfig.json to get improved type inference for `mitt` instance methods. ```ts import mitt from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter = mitt(); // inferred as Emitter emitter.on('foo', (e) => {}); // 'e' has inferred type 'string' emitter.emit('foo', 42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. (2345) ``` Alternatively, you can use the provided `Emitter` type: ```ts import mitt, { Emitter } from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter: Emitter = mitt(); ``` ## Examples & Demos Preact + Mitt Codepen Demo
* * * ## API #### Table of Contents - [mitt](#mitt) - [all](#all) - [on](#on) - [Parameters](#parameters) - [off](#off) - [Parameters](#parameters-1) - [emit](#emit) - [Parameters](#parameters-2) ### mitt Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub. Returns **Mitt** ### all A Map of event names to registered handler functions. ### on Register an event handler for the given type. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event ### off Remove an event handler for the given type. If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'` - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove ### emit Invoke all handlers for the given type. If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers. Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke - `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler ## Contribute First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! Now, take a moment to be sure your contributions make sense to everyone else. ### Reporting Issues Found a problem? Want a new feature? First of all see if your issue or idea has [already been reported](../../issues). If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new). ### Submitting pull requests Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits. - Fork it! - Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com//mitt` - Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt` - Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature` - Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`

## 核心实现、静态依赖与架构

### 1. 核心实现 (src/index.ts)
- **工厂函数** `mitt` (L46-L123)：返回包含 `all`、`on`、`off`、`emit` 的 `Emitter` 实例。
- **内部状态**：`all` 为 `Map`，键为事件类型（含 `'*'`），值为对应监听器数组。
- **方法实现**：
  - `on` (L66-L73)：按类型注册监听器，支持 `'*'` 通配符。
  - `off` (L82-L91)：移除指定监听器或清空某类型的所有监听器。
  - `emit` (L103-L121)：先执行类型匹配监听器，再执行 `'*'` 监听器。

### 2. 静态依赖
- **无外部依赖**：源码仅使用原生 `Map` 和数组方法，无第三方库导入。
- **构建工具**：`package.json` (L24) 使用 `microbundle` 打包为 ESM/CommonJS/UMD 格式。

### 3. 架构
- **单文件核心**：所有逻辑集中在 `src/index.ts`。
- **类型安全**：泛型 `Events` 定义事件类型映射，支持严格类型检查。
- **模块化输出**：`package.json` (L5-L8) 定义多格式导出路径。

It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Go check them out if you don't have them locally installed. ```sh $ npm install --save mitt ``` Then with a module bundler like [rollup](http://rollupjs.org/) or [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/), use as you would anything else: ```javascript // using ES6 modules import mitt from 'mitt' // using CommonJS modules var mitt = require('mitt') ``` The [UMD](https://github.com/umdjs/umd) build is also available on [unpkg](https://unpkg.com): ```html ``` You can find the library on `window.mitt`. ## Usage ```js import mitt from 'mitt' const emitter = mitt() // listen to an event emitter.on('foo', e => console.log('foo', e) ) // listen to all events emitter.on('*', (type, e) => console.log(type, e) ) // fire an event emitter.emit('foo', { a: 'b' }) // clearing all events emitter.all.clear() // working with handler references: function onFoo() {} emitter.on('foo', onFoo) // listen emitter.off('foo', onFoo) // unlisten ``` ### Typescript Set `"strict": true` in your tsconfig.json to get improved type inference for `mitt` instance methods. ```ts import mitt from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter = mitt(); // inferred as Emitter emitter.on('foo', (e) => {}); // 'e' has inferred type 'string' emitter.emit('foo', 42); // Error: Argument of type 'number' is not assignable to parameter of type 'string'. (2345) ``` Alternatively, you can use the provided `Emitter` type: ```ts import mitt, { Emitter } from 'mitt'; type Events = { foo: string; bar?: number; }; const emitter: Emitter = mitt(); ``` ## Examples & Demos Preact + Mitt Codepen Demo
* * * ## API #### Table of Contents - [mitt](#mitt) - [all](#all) - [on](#on) - [Parameters](#parameters) - [off](#off) - [Parameters](#parameters-1) - [emit](#emit) - [Parameters](#parameters-2) ### mitt Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub. Returns **Mitt** ### all A Map of event names to registered handler functions. ### on Register an event handler for the given type. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event ### off Remove an event handler for the given type. If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to unregister `handler` from, or `'*'` - `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove ### emit Invoke all handlers for the given type. If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers. Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported. #### Parameters - `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** The event type to invoke - `evt` **Any?** Any value (object is recommended and powerful), passed to each handler ## Contribute First off, thanks for taking the time to contribute! Now, take a moment to be sure your contributions make sense to everyone else. ### Reporting Issues Found a problem? Want a new feature? First of all see if your issue or idea has [already been reported](../../issues). If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new). ### Submitting pull requests Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits. - Fork it! - Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com//mitt` - Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt` - Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature` - Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). -   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)?** Handler function to remove

### emit

Invoke all handlers for the given type.
If present, `'*'` handlers are invoked after type-matched handlers.

Note: Manually firing '\*' handlers is not supported.

A Map of event names to registered handler functions.

Register an event handler for the given type.

### off

Remove an event handler for the given type.

根据项目文档和配置，以下是安装、开发、测试方式与入门建议：

## 安装方式
- 使用 npm 安装：`npm install --save mitt`
- 支持多种模块格式：
  - ESM: `import mitt from 'mitt'` (dist/mitt.mjs)
  - CommonJS: `var mitt = require('mitt')` (dist/mitt.js)
  - UMD: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/mitt/dist/mitt.umd.js"></script>`

## 开发方式
- 开发入口：`src/index.ts`
- 构建命令：`npm run build` (使用 microbundle 打包为 es/cjs/umd 格式)
- 清理构建：`npm run clean` (删除 dist 目录)
- 文档生成：`npm run docs` (使用 documentation 工具生成 API 文档)

## 测试方式
- 运行测试：`npm test` (执行 typecheck, lint, mocha, test-types)
- 单独运行 mocha 测试：`npm run mocha`
- 类型检查：`npm run typecheck` 或 `npm run test-types`
- 代码风格检查：`npm run lint`

## 入门建议
1. 确保已安装 Node.js 和 npm
2. 安装依赖：`npm install`
3. 阅读 README.md 了解基本用法
4. 查看 src/index.ts 理解核心实现
5. 运行 `npm test` 验证环境配置正确

## 候选改进建议
- 建议在 README 中补充更多复杂场景的使用示例（如动态添加/移除监听器）
- 考虑在文档中增加 TypeScript 泛型使用的高级示例
- 建议添加更多浏览器环境的使用示例（当前主要展示 Node.js 环境）

**注意**：以上改进建议仅作为贡献者参考，不冒充已有 issue。

# Mitt > Tiny 200b functional event emitter / pubsub. - **Microscopic:** weighs less than 200 bytes gzipped - **Useful:** a wildcard `"*"` event type listens to all events - **Familiar:** same names & ideas as [Node's EventEmitter](https://nodejs.org/api/events.html#events_class_eventemitter) - **Functional:** methods don't rely on `this` - **Great Name:** somehow [mitt](https://npm.im/mitt) wasn't taken Mitt was made for the browser, but works in any JavaScript runtime. It has no dependencies and supports IE9+. ## Table of Contents - [Install](#install) - [Usage](#usage) - [Examples & Demos](#examples--demos) - [API](#api) - [Contribute](#contribute) - [License](#license) ## Install This project uses [node](http://nodejs.org) and [npm](https://npmjs.com). Invoke all handlers for the given type.

## 安装方式
- 使用 npm 安装：`npm install --save mitt`
- 支持多种模块格式：
  - ESM: `import mitt from 'mitt'` (dist/mitt.mjs)
  - CommonJS: `var mitt = require('mitt')` (dist/mitt.js)
  - UMD: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/mitt/dist/mitt.umd.js"></script>`

- 开发入口：`src/index.ts`
- 构建命令：`npm run build` (使用 microbundle 打包为 es/cjs/umd 格式)
- 清理构建：`npm run clean` (删除 dist 目录)
- 文档生成：`npm run docs` (使用 documentation 工具生成 API 文档)

## 测试方式
- 运行测试：`npm test` (执行 typecheck, lint, mocha, test-types)
- 单独运行 mocha 测试：`npm run mocha`
- 类型检查：`npm run typecheck` 或 `npm run test-types`
- 代码风格检查：`npm run lint`

1. 确保已安装 Node.js 和 npm
2. 安装依赖：`npm install`
3. 阅读 README.md 了解基本用法

5. 运行 `npm test` 验证环境配置正确

根据项目文档和配置，以下是安装、开发、测试方式与入门建议：

## 安装方式
- 使用 npm 安装：`npm install --save mitt`
- 支持多种模块格式：
  - ESM: `import mitt from 'mitt'` (dist/mitt.mjs)
  - CommonJS: `var mitt = require('mitt')` (dist/mitt.js)
  - UMD: `<script src="https://unpkg.com/mitt/dist/mitt.umd.js"></script>`

## 开发方式
- 开发入口：`src/index.ts`
- 构建命令：`npm run build` (使用 microbundle 打包为 es/cjs/umd 格式)
- 清理构建：`npm run clean` (删除 dist 目录)
- 文档生成：`npm run docs` (使用 documentation 工具生成 API 文档)

## 测试方式
- 运行测试：`npm test` (执行 typecheck, lint, mocha, test-types)
- 单独运行 mocha 测试：`npm run mocha`
- 类型检查：`npm run typecheck` 或 `npm run test-types`
- 代码风格检查：`npm run lint`

## 入门建议
1. 确保已安装 Node.js 和 npm
2. 安装依赖：`npm install`
3. 阅读 README.md 了解基本用法
4. 查看 src/index.ts 理解核心实现
5. 运行 `npm test` 验证环境配置正确

## 候选改进建议
- 建议在 README 中补充更多复杂场景的使用示例（如动态添加/移除监听器）
- 考虑在文档中增加 TypeScript 泛型使用的高级示例
- 建议添加更多浏览器环境的使用示例（当前主要展示 Node.js 环境）

**注意**：以上改进建议仅作为贡献者参考，不冒充已有 issue。

If don't, just open a [new clear and descriptive issue](../../issues/new).

### Submitting pull requests

Pull requests are the greatest contributions, so be sure they are focused in scope, and do avoid unrelated commits.

-   Fork it!
-   Clone your fork: `git clone https://github.com/<your-username>/mitt`
-   Navigate to the newly cloned directory: `cd mitt`
-   Create a new branch for the new feature: `git checkout -b my-new-feature`
-   Install the tools necessary for development: `npm install`

### mitt

Mitt: Tiny (~200b) functional event emitter / pubsub.

Returns **Mitt** 

### all

A Map of event names to registered handler functions.

### on

Register an event handler for the given type.

#### Parameters

-   `type` **([string](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String) \| [symbol](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Symbol))** Type of event to listen for, or `'*'` for all events
-   `handler` **[Function](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Statements/function)** Function to call in response to given event

### off

Remove an event handler for the given type.
If `handler` is omitted, all handlers of the given type are removed.
